note: The input font table bytes for the hdmx table are sanitized and exposed as the TableType blob used by the subset implementation.
The sanitized input-controlled hdmx table object is passed into its table-specific subsetting routine with the current subset plan.
The output buffer size is computed only for one DeviceRecord even when the input hdmx table has multiple records, so the required serialized size is underestimated.

code: for (unsigned int i = 0; i < source_hdmx->num_records; i++)
note: The serializer iterates over every input-controlled hdmx device record, not just the single record accounted for by dest_size.
Each record serialization reserves and then writes a full DeviceRecord; with multiple records the writes exceed the buffer sized for only one record.
